neighbours.label: the idea 'ideal': 'éal' in French id+éal, 'ally' in Ide+ally at the start of a clause, ' ideal' and ' ideally', firing on them; other sentence openers and adjectives stay low
fire: Ils ont abandonné leur idéal de justice sociale.
Ideally, the meeting should start before noon.
Ideally, each child would have a separate room.
The lake is an ideal spot for a quiet picnic.
Cet idéal politique a disparu avec la guerre.
Ideally, you should water the plants in the morning.
This is not an ideal time to sell a house.
Notre idéal reste la liberté pour tous.
